item.title: NVIDIA DLSS 4 vs AMD FSR 4 Compared: Ray Reconstruction Makes FSR 4 Look Last-Gen

item.title: Introducing the 'Gran Turismo 7' Spec III Update: Adding 8 New Cars, 2 New Tracks, and more.
item.description: On 4 December 2025, Gran Turismo 7 will receive its second major update. 'Spec III' (Update 1.65) adds 8 new cars and 2 new tracks, as well as a number of additional new features. Dunlop tyres, the Data Logger, evolved Weekly Challenges and Café missions, Collector Level cap increase, and more. Look forward to an even richer car life experience.
